_comment: dbpedia-entities-openai-1M (1536d cosine, text-embedding-ada-002). Anchored on (recall, build_speed) for high-dim: pq_chunks=192 (8d/chunk) — high-dim PQ needs many subspaces or recall collapses; lower would be 'too small' per the brief. pruned_degree=96 / max_degree=128 — high-dim graphs benefit from denser local neighbourhoods (vs 64/96 for 96-128 dim). l_build=200 needed for high-dim graph quality. num_threads=32 and build_ram_limit_gb=64 (1M*1536*4B = 5.9 GB raw, plenty). search_list_size=300 widens search candidate pool for high-dim.
